# Starli Labs

> Donatas Tarasevičius builds apps, websites and plugins through Starli Labs, MB. Services include Wix and Shopify apps, WooCommerce plugins, custom websites, maintenance and improvements. Based in Kaunas, Lithuania. Project enquiries: hi@starli.app. Product support: support@starli.app.

## Start here
- [English homepage](https://starli.app/index.md): Full text version of the homepage, including services, selected work, existing review quotes and Donatas’s story.
- [Lietuviškai](https://starli.app/lt/index.md): Lietuviška pagrindinio puslapio tekstinė versija.
- [Portfolio](https://starli.app/labs/work.html): Project descriptions and links to their official listings.
- [Contact](https://starli.app/labs/contact.html): Email a description of the project, a website link and the intended result. There is no on-site appointment booking.

## Selected products
- [Digital Downloads](https://starli.app/labs/digital-downloads.html): Wix app for digital products and file delivery after purchase.
- [Search & Filter](https://starli.app/labs/search-filter.html): Product search and filters for Wix stores.
- [Bundles](https://starli.app/labs/bundles.html): Donatas’s work on a product bundles app. The homepage testimonials concern this app and its team’s support.
- [Starli Mind](https://starli.app/labs/starli-mind.html): Donatas’s first own iOS app.
